metadata.scope: 195 UN member and observer states, plus Taiwan and Kosovo as separate quiz categories; dependent territories excluded.
metadata.selection: Up to ten records per country, sorted by positive population estimate in SimpleMaps Basic v1.91.4; ranks refer to this source, not a uniform census ranking.

sources.name: SimpleMaps Basic World Cities v1.91.4
sources.attribution: City data: SimpleMaps.com. Filtered and enriched for this geography quiz.

metadata.difficultyMethod: Editorial global-recognition overrides for familiar cities; other cities use global population size and capital status as a rough recognizability proxy. National population rank is not used. These are subjective starting ratings, not survey-derived measurements.
notes: Population definitions and observation years vary; populationYear is null because the source does not provide a per-record year.
The free database is selective. Top-ten selection may miss cities and may include districts, towns or named populated places rather than ten independent cities, notably in city-states.
Coordinates are representative points; there is no uniquely exact city-centre location.
Continents use GeoNames country grouping, with city-level adjustments for Russia and Istanbul. The conventional continental boundary can be disputed.
Palestine combines the source Gaza Strip and West Bank categories before ranking.
Capitals follow the source primary-capital flag; countries with multiple capitals may not have every seat of government marked.
This broader dataset uses different population estimates from the earlier China 2020 urban-population list.
